instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that implements a synchronous 4-bit up-counter using the 16-bit adder module and a 2-to-1 multiplexer from the given prompt. The counter should increment on every positive clock edge and should reset to zero when the reset signal is asserted. The output of the counter should be selected by the select signal of the multiplexer. When select is 0, the output should be the binary representation of the count value, and when select is 1, the output should be the complement of the count value. You can use the 16-bit adder module to perform the addition operation and the 2-to-1 multiplexer to select the output value based on the select signal.
